candidates.formal_type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (V : Type u_3) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Ring.{u_2} A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} k A] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} V] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k V]
  [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u_3} A V] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k A V] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_3} k V],
  Exists.{1} fun n =>
    Exists.{u_3 + 1} fun W =>
      And
        (∀ (i : Fin n),
          Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_2, u_3} A (Subtype.{u_3 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_3, u_3} (W i) x))
        (And (Eq.{u_3 + 1} (iSup.{u_3, 1} W) Top.top.{u_3}) (iSupIndep.{1, u_3} W))

source_text: The existence proof proceeds by induction on dimension, splitting a decomposable representation into two proper summands and joining their inductive decompositions.
